title: Hida and Coleman families, Part II: higher coherent cohomology
summary: This Part II extends single-degree p-adic families to PEL analytic continuation, singular genus-two spherical control, Hilbert mixed ordinary families and doubling, completed-cohomology Eichler–Shimura comparisons, the singular Sen obstruction, and four integral projective Siegel Hida modules. It imports the already planned general supported Hida and Coleman theory by exact node identifiers. Integral, rational, cuspidal and noncuspidal hypotheses remain distinct, and unresolved analytic, descent and automorphic inputs remain explicit gaps.
readme: This roadmap begins after PadicFamilies single-degree ordinary and finite-slope families. It imports general supported Hida/Coleman theory from HigherHidaAndColemanTheory and adds the PEL, Hilbert and completed-cohomology refinements detailed in its reader. The plan distinguishes proven source statements, corrected proof steps and open supplier contracts; complete means every stage has a target-level plan, not that any declaration is formalized or that the graph is closed.

stages.title: PEL degrees and normalized correspondences
stages.description: Fix Morita-normalized degrees, the multi-place Iwahori correspondences and their scalar factors. Prove degree monotonicity and the uniform progress estimate used by continuation.

stages.title: PEL analytic continuation and classicality
stages.description: Construct the bad-complement filtration and Kassaei path sums. Prove bounded gluing and algebraization under an explicit positive-weight strict inequality; state the boundary and dimension hypotheses.

stages.title: Singular Siegel weight: spherical and slope refinements
stages.description: Extend the imported Klingen complex by the spherical operator, rank-zero nilpotence, a corrected BGG slope comparison, and the localized Euler theorem. Keep the stronger torsion claim as a conjectural boundary.

stages.title: Hilbert partial-ordinary Hida complexes
stages.description: Build the multivariable height-one tower, universal coefficient sheaf and normalized commuting operators. Prove fixed-weight amplitude and derived family control, keeping the precise degree-zero and degree-one spherical comparison.

stages.title: Hilbert weight-two doubling
stages.description: Define the partial Frobenius and its normalized trace actions. Prove the quadratic operator relation, generalized-eigenspace doubling injection and the two unit-root projectors without importing the stronger auxiliary vanishing theorem.

stages.title: Hilbert higher Coleman families and comparison
stages.description: Use analytic coefficient torsors on all mixed loci, finite perfect slope blocks and corrected relative BGG scaling. Prove multi-place small-slope continuation, then the rational one-Klingen-place ordinary comparison.

stages.title: Completed cohomology and Eichler–Shimura
stages.description: Bind the completed tower to coherent analytic localization. Construct the higher-Coleman spectral sequence and its arithmetic Sen action, with the ordinary degree indexing and the genus-two boundary localization explicit.

stages.title: Singular Sen operator and classicality
stages.description: At λ=(1,1;w), construct the two-step repeated Sen block. Identify its nilpotent map with the supported Cousin differential and deduce classicality from a de Rham eigenpacket with balanced four-piece multiplicities.

stages.title: Four integral projective Hida modules
stages.description: Extract the four finite projective genus-two modules from the imported ordinary complexes. Prove classical and higher-Coleman specialization, integral duality, tame group-ring projectivity and fixed-central-character base change.
